sql: SELECT main_cat, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY n DESC;
SELECT ref_id, prc, prc_usd, avg_rtg, main_cat FROM items_g2 LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fdbk_g2;
SELECT ref_id, COUNT(*) c, AVG(rtg) a, MIN(rtg) mn, MAX(rtg) mx FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY ref_id LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) total, COUNT(prc) prc_nn, COUNT(prc_usd) prc_usd_nn, COUNT(avg_rtg) rtg_nn FROM items_g2;
SELECT ref_id, item_id, uid, rtg FROM fdbk_g2 LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ref_id) FROM fdbk_g2;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fdbk_g2 f JOIN items_g2 i ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id;
SELECT i.ref_id, i.avg_rtg, f.a, f.c FROM items_g2 i JOIN (SELECT ref_id, AVG(rtg) a, COUNT(*) c FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY ref_id) f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE ABS(i.avg_rtg - f.a) > 0.01 LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM items_g2 i JOIN (SELECT ref_id, AVG(rtg) a, COUNT(*) c FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY ref_id) f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id;
SELECT MIN(prc), MAX(prc), MIN(prc_usd), MAX(prc_usd), AVG(prc), AVG(prc_usd) FROM items_g2;
SELECT ref_id, prc, prc_usd, main_cat FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10;

SELECT SUM(prc IS NULL AND prc_usd IS NULL) both_null, SUM(prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NULL) only_prc, SUM(prc IS NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL) only_usd, SUM(prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL) both FROM items_g2;
SELECT ref_id, prc FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NULL LIMIT 5;
SELECT ref_id, prc_usd FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL LIMIT 5;
SELECT main_cat, COUNT(*) n, MIN(prc) mn, MAX(prc) mx FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NULL GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 15;
SELECT MIN(prc), MAX(prc), SUM(prc/100.0 <> prc_usd) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL;
SELECT main_cat, COUNT(*) n, MIN(prc) mn, MAX(prc) mx FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 35;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 i JOIN (SELECT ref_id, COUNT(*) c, AVG(rtg) a FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY ref_id) f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE i.prc > 5000 AND f.c >= 5 AND f.a < 3.0;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 i JOIN (SELECT ref_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY ref_id) f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE i.prc > 5000 AND f.c >= 5 AND i.avg_rtg < 3.0;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 i JOIN (SELECT ref_id, COUNT(*) c, AVG(rtg) a FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY ref_id) f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE i.prc_usd > 50 AND f.c >= 5 AND f.a < 3.0;
SELECT main_cat, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g3 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 6;

SELECT i.ref_id, i.prc/100.0 usd, f.c, f.a, i.main_cat FROM items_g2 i JOIN (SELECT ref_id, COUNT(*) c, AVG(rtg) a FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY ref_id) f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE i.prc > 5000 AND f.c >= 5 AND f.a < 3.0 ORDER BY f.a;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer
FROM items_g2 i
JOIN (SELECT ref_id, COUNT(*) AS review_ct, AVG(rtg) AS avg_review_rtg FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY ref_id) r
  ON r.ref_id = i.ref_id
WHERE COALESCE(i.prc_usd, i.prc/100.0) > 50
  AND r.review_ct >= 5
  AND r.avg_review_rtg < 3.0;
